activity_statements.statement: operates full-service restaurants under The Cheesecake Factory brand with 250+ menu items made fresh from scratch in each restaurant kitchen
operates industrial bakery production facilities in California and North Carolina producing cheesecakes for its own restaurants, other restaurants and club store retailers
owns and operates North Italia, Fox Restaurant Concepts and approximately twelve additional restaurant brands acquired in 2019
operates Grand Lux Cafe restaurants as a sister concept to The Cheesecake Factory
operates international Cheesecake Factory restaurant locations through licensing in Middle East, Latin America and Asia

name_reality_gap: Name suggests a single dessert-focused restaurant; activity evidence shows a multi-brand restaurant group with industrial bakery manufacturing operations, 250-item scratch menus unusual for the industry, and wholesale supply of cheesecakes to other restaurants and retailers.
extraction_notes: Single strong source with detailed historical timeline. Restaurant brand acquisitions and bakery facilities clearly documented. Segment weight estimates are approximate.
